chapter.title: OF CONTEMPTS OF THE LAWFUL AUTHORITY OF PUBLIC SERVANTS

heading: False statement on oath or affirmation to public servant or person authorised to administer an oath or affirmation.
text: Whoever, being legally bound by an oath [1][or affirmation] to state the truth on any subject to any public servant or other person authorized by law to administer such oath [1][or affirmation], makes, to such public servant or other person as aforesaid, touching that subject, any statement which is false, and which he either knows or believes to be false or does not believe to be true, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, and shall also be liable to fine.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
